D: A primary school teacher accidentally promises that Hollywood is coming to see his school's nativity play.
P: Serve the sweets when the nativity play starts.
S: Warm mince pies with a spoon of cream, the staffroom treat every English school has in December.
Golden sausage rolls, the bake sale favourite at every school Christmas fair. Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion and roll in 2 sheets puff pastry.
M: Roast chicken with stuffing, roast potatoes and Brussels sprouts, an English Christmas dinner. Fill a whole chicken with stuffing from 150g breadcrumbs and herbs and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes with 800g potatoes.
W: Christmas pudding with warm custard poured over, the dessert after every school nativity. Heat an 800g Christmas pudding as the pack says.
K: a cold school day in December
Warm blackcurrant cordial in mugs, a cosy drink for kids.

s.how: Warm 12 mince pies at 160C for 10 minutes. Serve with 300ml whipped cream on the side. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Mix 500g sausage mince with 1 grated onion and roll in 2 sheets puff pastry. Cut into short lengths, brush with milk and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.how: Fill a whole chicken with stuffing from 150g breadcrumbs and herbs and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes with 800g potatoes. Roast 300g halved sprouts for the last 20 minutes.

w.how: Heat an 800g Christmas pudding as the pack says. Warm 500ml custard and pour over thick slices at the table. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.note: a cold school day in December
d.how: Pour 50ml blackcurrant cordial into each of 4 mugs and top with hot water. Stir and let cool a little before handing out. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
